content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

This is a complete digital commerce system designed to sell design assets—fonts, templates, presets, beats, plugins—without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or any third-party payment processor. It’s built on open infrastructure: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-10|COREMERCH guide to supabase]] or Google Sheets for order storage, and Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive for file delivery. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which accepts 300+ cryptocurrencies with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. The system is fully automated: when a payment confirms on-chain, the product is delivered instantly. You own the code, the data, and the deployment. There are no recurring fees, no platform lock-ins, and no geographic restrictions. This is infrastructure sovereignty—built for creators who need to operate outside the reach of conventional financial systems.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack starts with a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. The frontend is a simple HTML/CSS/JS interface where customers select products and pay in crypto. Behind the scenes, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic: verifying payments, logging orders, and triggering product delivery. NOWPayments acts as the payment gateway, converting USD prices to crypto at transaction time and firing a webhook when payment confirms. The order data is stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and the product files are stored in Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. When the webhook fires, the backend script generates a secure, time-limited download link and emails it to the customer. The entire system is stateless, serverless, and designed to scale without ongoing maintenance. You deploy it once, and it runs indefinitely—no servers to manage, no databases to patch.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators in regions where conventional payment processors are unavailable or unreliable—Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, Philippines, and others. If you sell design assets like fonts, templates, presets, beats, or plugins, this system lets you reach a global audience without depending on platforms that reject or restrict you. It’s also for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty: owning the tools that power their business instead of renting them. The system is intentionally simple—no complex setup, no ongoing fees, no vendor lock-in. It’s designed to work in environments with unstable currencies, unreliable internet, and financial isolation. If you’re tired of being locked out of the digital economy, this is your solution.
Own your infrastructure—no platforms, no subscriptions, no geographic restrictions.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack combines free and paid tools into a cohesive system. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide free, reliable hosting for your storefront. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without requiring server management. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data in a structured, queryable format. Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive serve product files securely and at scale. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and automatic webhooks. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes blueprints and templates for all components, plus a scaling playbook. Each component is replaceable—if you outgrow Google Sheets, swap it for Supabase. If you prefer BSC over Solana for low fees, configure NOWPayments accordingly. The system is modular, open, and fully under your control.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack for simplicity or Edge Commerce Stack for scalability. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to get all blueprints and templates. Follow the step-by-step deployment guide to set up hosting, backend logic, payment processing, and file delivery. Load your products into the system, configure NOWPayments for your preferred cryptocurrencies, and test the entire flow end-to-end. Once deployed, promote your storefront to your audience. The system handles payments, delivery, and order tracking automatically. You focus on creating, not on managing infrastructure. This is how you build a digital commerce business that cannot be shut down, restricted, or taken from you.

Follow the deployment guide to set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Configure backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Set up order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Upload product files to Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. 7. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto processing and configure webhooks. 8. Test the entire flow end-to-end: payment, order logging, and product delivery. 9. Launch your storefront and promote it to your audience. 10. Monitor transactions and scale the system as your business grows.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this system if I’ve never worked with crypto before?

Yes. NOWPayments handles crypto conversion automatically, and the Complete Builder Kit includes a detailed integration guide. Your customers pay in crypto, but you receive the equivalent value in USD at transaction time.
What if my customers don’t have crypto?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, including stablecoins pegged to USD. Recommend low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, or TRON to your customers for transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to manage servers or databases?
No. The system is serverless and stateless. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets store order data without requiring database management.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime, but the system is modular. You can replace it with another crypto payment processor if needed, though this would require reconfiguring webhooks.
Can I scale this system as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack is designed for scalability, and the Complete Builder Kit includes a scaling playbook. Swap Google Sheets for Supabase or upgrade hosting as needed.
